caseNameFull: Southeastern Express Company v. Stokes V. Robertson, State Revenue Agent, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Sanders McDaniel, Mr. A. S. Bozeman and Mr. H. L. Greene for appellant'. No appearance for appellees.

opinions.text: Dismissed with costs, without prejudice to the right of the appellant to prosecute its appeal in case (between same parties) now pending in this Court, being No. 216, October Term, 1923, on motion of counsel for appellant.
